name: Smart Splash Screen
author: susheelhbti

sections.description:
Smart Splash Screen lets you show a beautiful welcome popup to first-time visitors — and then stay out of the way. It uses a cookie so the popup only appears once per visitor (configurable). Everything is controlled from a clean Settings page — no coding required.

Key Features

  • ✅ Enable / disable with one click
  • 🍪 Cookie control — choose how many days to suppress the popup after dismiss
  • ⚡ AJAX dismiss — closes instantly with no page reload; server-side action hook fires on every dismiss
  • 📱 Mobile responsive — fluid card layout with clamp() fluid typography
  • 🎬 3 entry animations — Fade, Slide-up, or Zoom-in; respects prefers-reduced-motion
  • 🎨 Full appearance control — overlay background color, overlay opacity, and accent / button color
  • 📄 Page targeting — show on all pages, front page only, or specific page IDs
  • ⌨️ Fully accessible — role="dialog", aria-modal, Escape-key dismissal, focus trapping
  • 🔌 Shortcode support — embed any shortcode (contact forms, newsletter sign-ups, etc.) inside the popup
  • 🛡 Secure — nonce-verified AJAX, wp_kses_post, sanitize_hex_color, zero remote HTTP calls, zero eval

Shortcodes

[smart_splash]

Place on any page or post to force-show the popup regardless of the cookie.

[smart_splash_reset text="See welcome popup again"]

Renders a link that clears the dismiss cookie and reloads the page so the popup re-appears.

Developer Hook

do_action( 'sss_splash_dismissed' ) fires every time a visitor dismisses the popup via AJAX. Hook in to log analytics, send events, update user meta, etc.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-splash-screen folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Smart Splash to configure the popup content, behaviour, and appearance.
sections.faq:
Will the popup show every time?

No. After a visitor dismisses it, a cookie is set and the popup will not appear again for the number of days you configure (default: 7 days).

Can I embed a contact form or newsletter signup inside the popup?

Yes! Enter your form’s shortcode (without the square brackets) in the Embed shortcode field in the settings, and it will be rendered inside the popup.

How do I make the popup appear again for testing?

Use the [smart_splash_reset] shortcode, or simply clear your browser cookies and reload the page.

Does this plugin use jQuery or any external libraries?

No. The frontend JavaScript is plain vanilla JS (~2 KB). There are zero external dependencies and zero remote HTTP requests.

Is it accessible?

Yes. The popup uses role="dialog" and aria-modal="true", traps focus inside the modal while open, supports Escape-key dismissal, and respects the prefers-reduced-motion media query.

What PHP version do I need?

PHP 7.4 or higher is required.
